1 January 2026 | Thursday | 5:45 PM
Gulmohar Heights — Rathore Tower
Security desk par Chintu ke saath register ka kaam khatam karke Shreya apne tower ki taraf badhi.

Subah se lagataar chal raha din ab uske kandhon par mehsoos ho raha tha. Police station ki duty, training ground ki exercise aur phir society courtyard mein Samar-Shaan ke saath resistance challenge—sab milakar aaj achhi-khaasi physical activity ho gayi thi.

Courtyard ke waqt hi usne shirt trousers se untuck kar li thi aur neeche ka ek button khol diya tha. Baad mein, kuch der akele milne par, garmi se rahat paane ke liye upar ke do buttons bhi khol liye the.
Ab woh usi relaxed state mein ghar ja rahi thi. Shirt kamar ke paas loose thi, bag kandhe par aur ID clip ab bhi uniform ke front par lagi hui thi.
Lift se nikalte hue usne ghadi dekhi.
"Finally ghar. Aaj toh sach mein poora din nikal gaya."
Flat ke saamne pahunchkar Shreya ne bag se keys nikali.
Chaabi lock mein ghoomi, lekin darwaaza theek se nahi khula.
Usne dobara koshish ki.
Shreya: "Oh, come on! Ab tumhe kya ho gaya?"
Door halka sa khula, magar upar ka safety latch atak gaya tha. Shreya ne use do baar slide karne ki koshish ki. Metal ke andar se ek sookhi-si khat-khat hui, lekin latch nahi hila.
Usne phone nikala aur security desk par Chintu ko call kiya.
Shreya: "Chintu, ek minute mere flat tak aa sakte ho?"

Chintu: "Ji madam, aa raha hoon."

Uski nazar ek pal ke liye Shreya ki taraf gayi thi. Uniform ki front opening ab pehle jaisi nahi rahi thi.
Woh achanak chup ho gaya.
Agale hi pal usne nazar hata li aur darwaaze ke latch ko dekhne laga.
Shreya us waqt apne ID clip ki pin check kar rahi thi. Use shirt ke do buttons tootne ka pata nahi chala.
Shreya: "Chintu? Ho gaya?"
Chintu: "Ji... ji madam. Ho gaya."
Uski awaaz mein aayi halki hichkichahat par Shreya ne nazar uthayi.
Shreya: "Kya hua? Itna serious kyun ho gaye?"

Shreya ne darwaaza ek baar band karke dobara khola.
Is baar woh aasani se khul gaya.
Shreya: "Good. Kal maintenance ko bol dena isse properly check kare. Dobara atka toh problem hogi."

Usne apni pouch uthayi.
Chintu: "Ab latch theek hai, madam. Goodnight."
Shreya: "Thanks, Chintu. Goodnight."

Aur Chintu ka achanak chup ho jaana.

Ab use samajh aaya ki Chintu ki expression achanak kyun badli thi.

Kitna dekha tha, woh Shreya nahi jaanti thi. Chintu ne bhi kuch kaha nahi tha.
Woh ek pal mirror ke saamne khadi rahi, phir shirt ko sambhalte hue halki-si saans chhodi.

Baahar se ghar ki rozmarra ki halki awaazein aa rahi thi.
Shreya ne ek baar phir mirror mein dekha, phir fresh hone ke liye apni wardrobe ki taraf mud gayi.
